name: toy-shop
description: Three planted bugs in a tiny JS library. A smoke test for the harness, not a real benchmark.

tasks.title: Cart total ignores quantity
tasks.body: total([{ price: 10, quantity: 3 }]) returns 10 but it should be 30. Quantity isn't multiplied in.

tasks.title: applyDiscount subtracts the percent as a flat amount
tasks.body: applyDiscount(200, 25) returns 175. A 25% discount on 200 should be 150.

tasks.title: slugify keeps uppercase letters
tasks.body: slugify('Hello,  World!') returns 'Hello-World' but slugs must be lowercase: 'hello-world'.
